Abale atangokonzeka kuchoka, Yosefe anapatsa mtsogoleri wa nyumba yake malangizo awa: 'Dzaza masaka a amuna ndi tirigu ochuluka monga angathe kunyamula, ndipo bwezera ndalama ya aliyense pa mutu wa saka lake.
Ndipo ika kapu yanga ya siliva pa mutu wa saka la mng'ono kwambiri, pamodzi ndi ndalama ya tirigu wake.' Mtsogoleri anachita monga Yosefe anamuuza.
M'mawa wake abale ananyamulira masaka awo abulu nacha ulendo.
Koma asanathamangire kutali ndi mzinda, Yosefe anauza mtsogoleri wake, 'Thamutsira amuna aja nakawazime. Ukawapeze, uwauze, "N'chifukwa chiyani mwabweza ubwino ndi zoipa?
N'chifukwa chiyani mwaba kapu ya siliva ya mbuye wanga, imene amagwiritsa ntchito kulosera? Muchita zoyipa kotere!"'
Mtsogoleri atafikira amuna, anauza monga Yosefe anamuuza.
'Mbuye wathu akuyankhula chiyani?' abale anayankha. 'Ife atumiki akowo sisingathe kuchita zimenezi!
Kodi tibwereretsa ndalama imene tapeza m'masaka athu yochokera ku Kanani? Bwanji tiba siliva kapena golide ya nyumba ya mbuye wako?
Pezani kapu ya siliva mwa mmodzi wathu, iye afe. Ndipo ife onse tikhale akapolo a mbuye wathu.'
'Chabwino,' munthuyo anauza. 'Koma woliba kapu yekha akhale kapolo wanga. Ena anu apite mwaulere.'
Aliyense mwamsanga anachotsa saka lake pa msana wa bulu wake natsekulira.
Mtsogoleri anafufuza masaka, kuyambira wamkulu mpaka wamng'ono. Ndipo kapu inapezeka m'saka la Benyamini!
Abale ataona ichi, anathyola zoval zawo mwachisoni. Pamenepo analembera abulu awo nakaweramu ku mzinda.
Yosefe anali m'nyumba nthawi imene Yuda ndi abale ake anafika, ndipo iwo anagwa pansi pamaso pake.
'Ndi chiyani chimene mwachita?' Yosefe anafunsa. 'Kodi simukudziwa kuti munthu ngati ine angathe kulosera?'

Yuda anayankha, 'Tinenani chiyani mbuye wathu? Tifotokozere bwanji? Titsimikizire bwanji kuti tili opanda mulandu? Mulungu waona machimo athu. Tsopano ife tonse tili akapolo a mbuye wathu, ife ndi amene anali ndi kapu m'saka lake.'
'Ayi,' Yosefe anauza. 'Sindingathe kuchita zimenezi! Woliba kapu yekha akhale kapolo wanga. Ena anu abwelerani kwa bambo wanu mwamtendere.'
Pamenepo Yuda anapita patsogolo nanena, 'Chonde mbuye wanga, lolani mtumiki wanu kunena mawu amodzi mbuye wanga. Musakwiyire, ngakhale muli ndi mphamvu ngati Farao mwini wake.
Mbuye wanga, kale munafunsa ife atumiki anu, "Kodi muli ndi bambo kapena mchimwene?"

Ndipo tinayankha, "Inde mbuye wathu, tili ndi bambo wakalamba, ndipo mwana wake wamng'ono ndi mwana wa nthawi yakuchindikira kwake. Mchimwene wake wamkulu wafa, ndipo iye yekha wasara wa amayi ake, ndipo bambo wake amamkonda kwambiri."
Pamenepo mbuye wanga anauza, "Mubwere naye kuno kuti ndimuwone ndi maso anga."
Koma tinauza mbuye wathu, "Mwana sakhoza kusiya bambo wake, pakuti bambo wake angafa."
Koma mbuye wanga anauza, "Mukasakubweretsa mchimwene wanu wamng'ono, simudzandionanso."
Choncho tinabwerera kwa atumiki anu bambo wathu, ndinauza zimene mbuye wanga ananena.
Pambuyo pake bambo wathu anauza, "Bwelerani ndipo mukagule chakudya china,'
koma tinauza, "Sitingapite mukasakutumizira mchimwene wathu wamng'ono nafe. Sitidzaonanso nkhope ya munthuyo mchimwene wathu wamng'ono asapita nafe."
Bambo wathu anauza, "Mukudziwa kuti mkazi wanga anandibadwira ana awiri,
ndipo mmodzi anachoka ndipo sanabwerenso. Pakuonekera kuti nyama yamwanda yam'dya. Sinam'onanso.
Tsopano mukamutenga mwana wina ndi inu, ndipo china china chamuphere, mudzatumiza nkhope iyi yakuda ya nkhawa ku manda.'
Choncho tsopano mbuye wanga, sindingathe kubwerera kwa bambo wanga mwana asapita nafe. Moyo wa bambo wathu ulangika ndi moyo wa mwana.
Ataona kuti mwana sali nafe, bambo wathu adzafa. Ife atumiki anu tidzakhala ndi mulandu wotumiza nkhope iyi yakuda ndi nkhawa ya bambo wathu ku manda.
Mbuye wanga, ine ndinalumbirira kwa bambo wanga kuti ndidzasamalira mwana. Ndinauza, "Ngati sindibweretsa kwa iwe, ndidzakhala ndi mulandu kwamuyaya."
Choncho mbuye wanga, lolani ine kapolo wako ndikakhale m'malo mwa mwana kuti mwana apite ndi abale ake.
Pakuti ndibwere bwanji kwa bambo wanga mwana asapita nafe? Sindingaone chisoni chimene chidzagwera bambo wanga!'
Yosefe sanakwanire kudziletsa. Anali ndi anthu ambiri m'chipindamo, choncho anafuula, 'Tulukani nonse!' Motero anakhala yekha ndi abale ake, ndipo anaudza kuti ndiye yani.
Pamenepo analira mokamwa kwambiri kotero kuti aEgipito anamva, ndipo mbiri inafika ku nyumba ya Farao.
'Ndine Yosefe!' anauza abale ake. 'Bambo wanga ali ndi moyo?' Koma abale ake sanayankhe kalikonse — anachita mantha kwambiri kuona Yosefe pamaso pawo.
'Yandikirani,' anauza kwa iwo. Choncho anayandikira. Ndipo anauza, 'Ine ndine Yosefe mchimwene wanu, amene mudagulitsa ku Igupito.
Koma musachite chisoni, musapsye mtima chifukwa cha kundigulitsa kuno — Mulungu ndiye anutumiza kuno kusunga miyoyo yanu.
Zaka ziwiri tsopano dziko linali ndi njala, ndipo zaka zisanu zikubwera zimene kulima ndi kukolola kudzakhala kosiye.
Mulungu anutumiza kuno patsogolo pa inu kuti akusunga ndi moyo inu ndi mabanja anu ndi kupulumutsa anthu ambiri.
Choncho si inu amene munanditumiza kuno, koma Mulungu! Iye ndiye amene anandipanga wolamulira wa nyumba ya Farao, woyang'anira nyumba yake yonse, ndi wolamulira dziko lonse la Igupito.
Dali ndipo pitani kwa bambo wanga ndipo mumuuze, "Mwana wako Yosefe akuuza izi: Mulungu wandipanga wolamulira dziko lonse la Igupito. Tsikani kuno mwamsanga!
Mudzakhala m'dera la Gosheni, pafupi ndi ine, inu ndi ana anu ndi zidzukulu zanu, ndi nkhosa ndi ng'ombe zanu ndi chilichonse chimene muli nacho.
Ndidzakusamalirani kumeneko, pakuti zaka zisanu za njala zakhalabe zikubwera. Musakakumane ndi njala, inu ndi nyumba yanu ndi chilichonse chimene muli nacho.'"
Pamenepo Yosefe anaonjezera, 'Taonani, inu nonse ndi mchimwene wanga Benyamini mungazindikire kuti ine mwini ndine Yosefe!
Uzani bambo wanga za ulemu wanga wonse wano ku Igupito. Mufotokozere zonse zimene mwaona, ndipo mubwere naye bambo wanga mwamsanga.'
Pamenepo analira m'chisangalalo, nakwatira Benyamini mchimwene wake, ndipo Benyamini anachitanso choncho.
Pamenepo Yosefe anamupsya abale ake onse ndi kulira. Pambuyo pake abale anayankhula nawo mwaulere.
Mbiri inafika posachedwa ku nyumba ya Farao kuti abale a Yosefe anafika. Farao ndi akaanga ake onse anasangalala kumva ichi.
Farao anauza Yosefe, 'Uze abale ako, "Ichi ndichi chimene muzichita: Lemezani ziweto zanu ndipo mubwere ku dziko la Kanani.
Kenaka dzetsa bambo wako ndi mabanja anu onse, ndipo bwelerani kuno. Ndidzakupatsa nthaka yabwino kwambiri ya Igupito, ndipo mudzadya mmene dziko limabereka.'"
Pamenepo Farao anauza Yosefe, 'Uze abale ako, "Tengani ngolo kuchokera ku Igupito kwa ana anu ang'ono ndi akazi anu ndipo dzetsani bambo wanu kuno.
Musade nkhawa za zinthu zanu, pakuti zinabwino zonse za Igupito ndi zanu."'
Choncho ana a Yakobo anachita monga anauziwa. Yosefe anawapatsa ngolo monga Farao analamula, ndipo anawapatsa zosangalala za ulendo.
Komanso anapatsa aliyense zoval zatsopano, koma Benyamini anapatsa zoval zisanu ndi ziwiri ndi siliva mazana atatu.
Anatumizira bambo wake abulu khumi aonyamula zokometsera zabwino za Igupito, ndi abulu achikazi khumi anyamula tirigu ndi mkate ndi zosangalala zina za ulendo.
Choncho Yosefe anatumiza abale ake, ndipo atachoka anauza, 'Musachitane mkangano m'njira!'
Choncho anachoka ku Igupito nabwerera kwa bambo wawo Yakobo m'dziko la Kanani.
'Yosefe ali ndi moyo!' iwo anauza. 'Ndipo ndi wolamulira dziko lonse la Igupito!' Yakobo anangokodola, sanakhulupirire.
Koma atamvera zonse zimene Yosefe anauza iwo, nataona ngolo zimene Yosefe anatuma kum'tenga, mtima wa bambo wawo Yakobo unakhala mwatsopano.
Pamenepo Yakobo anatukuma, 'Ndi zoona! Mwana wanga Yosefe ali ndi moyo! Ndiyenera kupita kukamuwona asanafe!'
Choncho Yakobo ananyamuka ndi zinthu zake zonse. Atafika ku Beerisheba, anapereka nsembe kwa Mulungu wa bambo wake Isaki.
Usiku umenewo Mulungu analankhula naye m'masomphenya. 'Yakobo! Yakobo!' anaitana. 'Ndili pano,' Yakobo anayankha.
'Ine ndine Mulungu, Mulungu wa bambo wako,' mawu anauza. 'Usaope kutsika ku Igupito, pakuti kumeneko ndidzakupanga mtundu waukulu.
Ndidzatsika nako ku Igupito, ndipo ndidzakubwereretsa. Yosefe adzatseka maso ako nthawi ya kumwalira kwako.'
Choncho Yakobo anachoka ku Beerisheba, ndipo ana ake anam'teka ku Igupito. Anam'nyamula iye ndi ana ang'ono ndi akazi m'ngolo zimene Farao anatuma.
Anatenga komanso ziweto zawo zonse ndi chuma chonse chimene anagwira m'dziko la Kanani. Choncho Yakobo ndi mzikomo wake wonse anapita ku Igupito,
ana ake aamuna ndi zidzukulu zawo, ana ake aakazi ndi zidzukulu zawo, mzikomo wake wonse.
Awa ndi mayina a ana a Israeli amene anapita ku Igupito, Rubeni mwana woyamba kubadwa wa Yakobo.
Ana a Rubeni anali Hanoki, Palu, Hezroni, ndi Karimi.
Ana a Simiyoni anali Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Zohari, ndi Shauli, amene amayi ake anali mwananamwali wKanani.
Ana a Levi anali Gershoni, Kohati, ndi Merari.
Ana a Yuda anali Eri, Onani, Shela, Perezi, ndi Zerahi, ngakhale Eri ndi Onani anamwalira m'dziko la Kanani. Ana a Perezi anali Hezroni ndi Hamuli.
Ana a Isakari anali Tola, Pua, Yashibu, ndi Shimironi.
Ana a Zebuloni anali Seredi, Eloni, ndi Yaleli.
Awa ndi ana a Leya ndi Yakobo amene anabadwira ku Padani-Aramu, kuphatikiza mwana wawo wachikazi Dina. Zidzukulu za Yakobo kudzera mwa Leya anali makumi atatu ndi atatu.
Ana a Gadi anali Zefoni, Hagi, Shuni, Eziboni, Eri, Arodi, ndi Areli.
Ana a Asheri anali Imina, Ishiva, Ishivi, ndi Beriya. Mlongo wawo anali Sera. Ana a Beriya anali Heberi ndi Malkieli.
Awa anali ana a Zilipa amene Labani anamupatsa Leya mwana wake. Zidzukulu za Yakobo kudzera mwa Zilipa anali khumi ndi isita.
Ana a Raeli mkazi wa Yakobo anali Yosefe ndi Benyamini.
Ana a Yosefe amene anabadwira m'dziko la Igupito anali Manase ndi Efiraimu. Amayi awo anali Asenati mwana wa Potifera wansembe wa Oni.
Ana a Benyamini anali Bela, Bekeri, Ashibeli, Gera, Naamani, Ehi, Roshi, Mupimi, Hupimi, ndi Ardi.
Awa anali ana a Raeli ndi Yakobo. Zidzukulu za Yakobo kudzera mwa Raeli anali khumi ndi anayi.
Mwana wa Dani anali Hushimu.
Ana a Nafitali anali Yahizeli, Guni, Yezeri, ndi Shilemu.
Awa anali ana a Bilha amene Labani anamupatsa Raeli mwana wake. Zidzukulu za Yakobo kudzera mwa Bilha anali asanu ndi awiri.
Chiwerengero cha zidzukulu zenizeni za Yakobo zimene zinafika naye ku Igupito, osachita akazi a ana ake aamuna, chinali makumi asita ndi isita.
Kuphatikiza ana awiri a Yosefe amene anabadwira ku Igupito, anthu onse a mzikomo wa Yakobo ku Igupito anali makumi asanu ndi awiri.
Yakobo anatumiza Yuda patsogolo kwa Yosefe kuti amutsogolere ku Gosheni. Atafika kumeneko,
Yosefe anakonzera galeta lake napita ku Gosheni kakakumana ndi bambo ake Yakobo. Yosefe atafika, anakwatira bambo wake nalira, namukwatirira nthawi yayitali.
Pamapeto pake Yakobo anauza Yosefe, 'Tsopano ndimangomalizika ndi moyo, popeza ndaona nkhope yako ndipo ukali ndi moyo.'
Pamenepo Yosefe anauza abale ake ndi mzikomo wa bambo wake wonse, 'Ndidzapita kwa Farao ndipo ndidzamuuza, "Abale anga ndi mzikomo wa bambo wanga wachokera ku dziko la Kanani wandifikira.
Iwo ndi abusa ndipo amameta ziweto. Tabwera ndi nkhosa ndi ng'ombe zawo ndi chilichonse chimene ali nacho."'
Pamenepo anauza, 'Farao akakuitanani nakufunsani za ntchito yanu,
muyankhe, "Ife atumiki anu tameta ziweto kuyambira umwana mpaka lero, monga makolo athu anachita." Izi zidzakupatsa chilolezo chokukhala m'dera la Gosheni, chifukwa aEgipito amadana ndi abusa.'
Pamenepo Yosefe anapita kwa Farao nanena, 'Bambo wanga ndi abale anga anafika kuchokera ku dziko la Kanani ndi nkhosa ndi ng'ombe zawo ndi chuma chawo chonse. Ali m'dera la Gosheni.'
Yosefe anatenga abale ake asanu nakawayimitsa pamaso pa Farao.
Farao anafunsa abale, 'Ntchito yanu n'chiyani?' Iwo anayankha, 'Ife atumiki anu tili abusa, monga makolo athu anali.
Tabwera kukhala pang'ono m'dziko lino, pakuti palibe busa kwa nkhosa zathu ku Kanani. Njala yaikulu kwambiri kumeneko. Choncho tikupempha chilolezo chokukhala m'dera la Gosheni.'
Pamenepo Farao anauza Yosefe, 'Bambo wako ndi abale ako atafikira kwa iwe,
sanka m'dziko lonse la Igupito malo abwino kwa iwo. Khalitsani m'dera la Gosheni, nthaka yabwino kwambiri. Ngati ena mwa iwo ali ndi luso lapadera, waikira kusamalira ziweto zanga.'
Pamenepo Yosefe anabweretsa bambo ake Yakobo nayimitsira pamaso pa Farao. Ndipo Yakobo anadalitsa Farao.
'Kodi mwakalamba zaka zingati?' Farao anam'funsa.
Yakobo anayankha, 'Ndayenda pa dziko lapansi lino zaka 130 zovuta. Koma zaka zanga ndi zochepa ndi zovuta kupambana za makolo anga m'ulendo wawo.'
Pamenepo Yakobo anabitiranso Farao dalitso asanachoke kunyumba yake yachifumu.
Choncho Yosefe anaika bambo ake ndi abale ake m'nthaka yabwino kwambiri ya Igupito, m'dera la Ramesesi, monga Farao analamula.
Ndipo Yosefe anapatsa bambo ake ndi abale ake ndi nyumba yake yonse chakudya chochuluka monga mzikomo ulikuwera.
Panthawiyi, njala inali yaikulu kwambiri kotero kuti chakudya chatha padziko lonse, ndipo anthu anali akufa ndi njala ku Igupito ndi ku Kanani.
Pogulitsa tirigu kwa anthu, Yosefe anasonkhanitsa ndalama yonse ya ku Igupito ndi ya ku Kanani, nakayika ndalama yonse m'nyumba ya chuma ya Farao.
Ndalama ya ku Igupito ndi ya ku Kanani itatha, aEgipito onse anabwera kwa Yosefe. 'Ndalama yathu yatha!' iwo analirika. 'Koma tiperekere chakudya, kapena tidzafa pamaso pako!'
Yosefe anauza, 'Ndalama yathera, bweresani ziweto zanu. Ndidzakupatsani chakudya m'malo mwa ziweto zanu.'
Choncho anabweretsa ziweto zawo kwa Yosefe, ndipo iye anawapatsa chakudya m'malo mwa akavalo, nkhosa, ng'ombe, ndi abulu zawo. Pa chaka chimenechi anawapatsa chakudya m'malo mwa ziweto zawo zonse.

Koma chaka chimenechi chitha, iwo anabweranso chaka chotsatira nati, 'Sitingabise kwa mbuye wanga. Ndalama yatha ndi ziweto zonse zinali zathu ndi za mbuye wathu. Tilibe chilichonse chosara popatsa mbuye wathu kupatula thupi lathu ndi nthaka yathu.

N'chifukwa chiyani tiwe pamaso pako? Tigule, ife ndi nthaka yathu m'malo mwa chakudya; tipereke ife ndi nthaka yathu kukhala akapolo a Farao. Ndipo utipatse mbewu kuti tikhale ndi moyo, ndipo nthaka isasiwe yopanda anthu.'
Choncho Yosefe anagula nthaka yonse ya ku Igupito kwa Farao. AEgipito onse anagulitsa minda yawo chifukwa njala inali yaikulu kwambiri, ndipo posachedwa nthaka yonse inali ya Farao.
Ndipo anapanga anthu onse kukhala akapolo, kuyambira kumapeto kumodzi kwa Igupito mpaka kwa kumzake.
Nthaka yokha imene sanagule inali ya ansembe. Iwo analipidwa chakudya kuchokera kwa Farao mwachinsinsi, choncho sanafunikenso kugulitsa nthaka yawo.
Pamenepo Yosefe anauza anthu, 'Taonani, lero ndagula inu ndi nthaka yanu kwa Farao. Ndikupatsa mbewu kuti mulime minda.
Ndipo mukakolola, gawo la chinayi cha zokolola lilizonse likhale la Farao. Makhala ana atatu a zinayi zikhale zanu, zopanda mbewu ya minda ndi chakudya kwa inu ndi nyumba yanu ndi ana anu ang'ono.'
'Mupulumutsa miyoyo yathu!' iwo anafuula. 'Tiloleni mbuye wathu, ndikhale akapolo a Farao.'
Choncho Yosefe anapanga lamulo loyenera ku Igupito mpaka lero kuti Farao alandire gawo la chinayi la zokolola zonse. Nthaka ya ansembe yekha sinayikhidwe kwa Farao.
Panthawiyi, anthu a Israeli anakhala m'dera la Gosheni ku Igupito. Iwo analandira nthaka kumeneko ndipo anakula ndi kuchuluka kwambiri.
Yakobo anakhala ku Igupito zaka khumi ndi zisanu ndi ziwiri, ndipo anakhala zaka 147 zake zonse.

Nthawi ya imfa yake itayandikira, Yakobo anaitana mwana wake Yosefe nati, 'Chonde ndichitire chisomo ichi. Ika dzanja lako pansi pa ntchafu yanga ndi kulumbirira kuti udzanditendela ndi chikondi ndi kukhulupirika: Usandike ku Igupito.
Ndikamwalira, nditenga kuchokera ku Igupito ndundike pamodzi ndi makolo anga.' Yosefe analonjeza, 'Ndidzachita monga unena.'
'Lumbira,' Yakobo anakakamiza. Choncho Yosefe analumbira, ndipo Yakobo anapinda msana wake pa mutu wa bedi.
Patapita nthawi pang'ono, Yosefe anauziwa, 'Bambo wako akuonanso bwino.' Choncho Yosefe anapita kamuwona, natenga ana ake awiri, Manase ndi Efiraimu.
Yakobo atauziwa kuti 'Mwana wako Yosefe akubwera kukuona,' anasonkhanitsa mphamvu zake nakakhala pa bedi.
Yakobo anauza Yosefe, 'Mulungu Wamphamvu anakuonekera ku Luzi m'dziko la Kanani namudalitsa.

Anauza, "Ndidzakupanga kubereka ndi kukuchulukitsa zidzukulu zako. Ndidzakupanga mitundu yambiri. Ndipo ndidzapereka dziko ino la Kanani kwa zidzukulu zako pambuyo pako ngati chuma chathu kwamuyaya."'
'Tsopano ana ako awiri amene anakubadwira kuno ku Igupito asanabwere kuno, Efiraimu ndi Manase, ndidzawatenga ngati ana anga wekha. Akhale ngati Rubeni ndi Simiyoni kwa ine.
Koma ana amene udzababala pambuyo pawo adzakhala ako, ndipo iwo adzalandira chuma m'madera a Efiraimu ndi Manase mwa abale awo.

Kale ndinakolera kuchokera ku Padani-Aramu, Raeli anamwalira m'dziko la Kanani m'njira, ali akatali ndi Efrata. Ndi chisoni chachikulu ndinamdika komeneko m'njira ya ku Efrata, imene tsopano imatchedwa Betelehemu.'
Pamenepo Yakobo analuntha maso pa ana awiri. 'Awa ndi ana anu?' anafunsa.
'Inde,' Yosefe anauza, 'awa ndi ana amene Mulungu wandipatsa kuno ku Igupito.' Yakobo anauza, 'Bweresani kuno kuti ndiwadale.'
Maso a Yakobo anali afutsa chifukwa cha nthawi yakuchindikira kwake ndipo sanakwanire kuona bwino. Yosefe anapitisa ana pafupi ndi iye, ndipo Yakobo anawapha nawadale.
Pamenepo Yakobo anauza Yosefe, 'Sindinaganizira kukuonanso nkhope yako, koma tsopano Mulungu wandiloleza kuona ana akonso!'
Yosefe anachotsa ana kwa agogo wawo amene anali pa mawondo ake, nagwa nkhope yake pansi.
Pamenepo anaika ana patsogolo pa Yakobo. Dzanja lake lamanja analiyang'aniza Efiraimu kumanzere kwa Yakobo, ndipo ndi dzanja lake lamanzere anaika Manase kudzanja lamanja kwa Yakobo.

Koma Yakobo anaolola manja ake pamene anatambasula kuyika manja pa mutu wa ana. Anaikira dzanja lake lamanja pa mutu wa Efiraimu, ngakhale anali mng'ono, ndipo dzanja lake lamanzere pa mutu wa Manase, ngakhale anali wamkulu.
Pamenepo anamudalitsa Yosefe nanena, 'Mulungu amene makolo anga Abrahamu ndi Isaki adayendera pamaso pake, Mulungu amene wandisamalira ngati mwana wamkono kuyambira kubadwira kwanga mpaka lero,
Mngelo amene wandipulumutsa ku zoipa zonse, iye adalitse ana awa. Adzatchedwe pa dzina langa ndi pa dzina la makolo anga Abrahamu ndi Isaki, ndipo zidzukulu zawo zichuluke kwambiri pa dziko lapansi.'
Koma Yosefe sanapindule ataona kuti bambo wake waikira dzanja lake lamanja pa mutu wa Efiraimu. Choncho analitenga kulisuntha kuchokera pa mutu wa Efiraimu kupita pa mutu wa Manase.
'Ayi bambo,' anauza. 'Uyu ndiye wamkulu. Ika dzanja lako lamanja pa mutu wake.'

Koma bambo wake anakana. 'Ndidziwa mwana wanga, ndidziwa,' anayankha. 'Manase komanso adzakhala mtundu waukulu. Koma mchimwene wake wamng'ono adzapambana kwambiri, ndipo zidzukulu zake zidzakhala mitundu yambiri.'

Choncho Yakobo anawapatsa dalitso pa tsiku limenelo nati, 'Anthu a Israeli adzagwiritsa ntchito mayina anu ali pempho la dalitso. Adzati, "Mulungu akupange ngati Efiraimu ndi Manase."' Motero Yakobo anaika Efiraimu patsogolo pa Manase.
Pamenepo Yakobo anauza Yosefe, 'Taona, ndikulowa imfa, koma Mulungu adzakhala ndi inu ndipo adzakubweretsa ku dziko la Kanani la makolo anu.
Ndipo kuphatikiza zimene ndapatsa abale ako, ndikupatsa iwe gawo lina la nthaka limene ndinatenga kwa aAmori ndi lupanga langa ndi uta wanga.'
Pamenepo Yakobo anaitana ana ake onse nati, 'Sonkhanani pano kuti ndikuuzeni zimene zidzachitikira aliyense wa inu m'tsogolo.
Sonkhanani ndimvere, inu ana a Yakobo; imverani Israeli bambo wanu.
Rubeni, iwe ndiwe mwana wanga woyamba kubadwa, mphamvu yanga, choyamba cha mphamvu yanga yachichepere. Woyamba pakumutu ndi woyamba pa mphamvu.
Koma sukhala woyamba, chifukwa unali wosayendera monga madzi akukumba. Unagona ndi mkazi wa bambo wako, unayipitsa bedi lake.
Simiyoni ndi Levi ndi abale; mapanga awo ndi zida za chiopsyezo.
Ndisasokonezeke m'misonkhano yawo; ndisakhale m'msonkhano wawo wa chinsinsi. Pakuti m'mkwiyo wawo anapha anthu, ndi m'chidukwa chawo anagwentula ng'ombe.
Temberani mkwiyo wawo, pakuti wachinanazi; ndi ukali wawo, pakuti wonenetsa. Ndidzawagazika pakati pa zidzukulu za Yakobo, ndipo ndidzawafalitsa m'Israeli.
Yuda, abale ako adzakutamanda. Udzagwira adani ako pa khosi. Ana a bambo wako adzagwa nkhope zawo pansi pamaso pako.
Yuda ndi mwana wansomba umene wathera kudya. Ngati mkango yagona pansi; ngati mkango wachikazi, ndani adzam'dzutse?
Ndodo ya ufumu sidzachoka kwa Yuda, kapena wosewera nkhombwe ku zidzukulu zake, mpaka kubwera kwa iye amene ndi wake, amene mitundu yonse idzamlemekeza.
Iye amangira bulu wake pa mpesa, mwana wake wa bulu pa mpesa wosankhidwa. Asamba zoval zake m'vinyo, zibena zake m'magazi a mpesa.
Maso ake ndi amdima kupambana vinyo, mano ake ndi oyera kupambana mkaka.
Zebuloni adzakhala pafupi ndi nyanja ndipo adzakhala doko ya sitima; malire ake afikire ku Sidoni.
Isakari ndi bulu wamphamvu, wapumzika pakati pa matumba awiri.
Ataona kuti busa la tchire labwino ndi dziko lokongola, anagwera mapewa ake pa katundu ndi kutenga ntchito yovuta.
Dani adzalamulira anthu ake, ngati fuko lina m'Israeli.
Dani adzakhala njoka m'mbali mwa msewu, njoka yopha m'mbali mwa njira imene idula chidole cha kavalo kotero kuti wokhala pa iye agwe kumbuyo.
Ine ndiyembekezera chipulumutso chako, Yehova!
Gadi adzagweredwa ndi magulu a olanda, koma iye adzawagwera iwo atabwerera.
Asheri adzadya chakudya chochuluka cha mafuta ndipo adzapatsa mafumu chakudya chosangalatsa.
Nafitali ndi mwana wa mbuzi wosungunuka, wotulutsa ana okongola.
Yosefe ndi mpanda wobereka pafupi ndi kasupe; nthambi zake zifalikira pa phiri.
Owombera uta anam'gweretsa ndi mkali; anam'taya ndi kulimbana naye.
Koma uta wake unakhalabe wamphamvu, ndipo manja ake anakhala okangalika ndi dzanja la Wamphamvu wa Yakobo, ndi Mwana wamkono, Thanthwe la Israeli.
Mulungu wa bambo wako akuthandize; Wamphamvu akudalitse ndi madalitso a kumwamba, ndi madalitso a nyanja ya pansi, ndi madalitso a maparamita ndi mimba.
Madalitso a bambo wako apambane madalitso a makolo anga; afikire nyanja za mapiri amuyaya. Akhale pa mutu wa Yosefe, pa nkhata ya mtsogoleri pakati pa abale ake.
Benyamini ndi mbunda yoyipa ikulya adani wake m'mawa ndipo igawane zokanda madzulo.'
Awa ndi mafuko khumi ndi awiri a Israeli, ndipo ichi ndi chimene bambo wawo ananena atawauzira nkhalamba. Anawapatsa aliyense dalitso loyenera.
Pamenepo Yakobo analamula, 'Posachedwa ndidzamwalira ndipo ndidzapita pamodzi ndi makolo anga. Ndikeni pamodzi ndi bambo wanga ndi agogo wanga m'phanga la m'munda wa Efroni wHiti,
m'phanga la Makipela pafupi ndi Mamre m'dziko la Kanani, limene Abrahamu anagula kwa Efroni wHiti kukhala malo okaikidwa kwamuyaya.
Komeneko ndi kumene anaika Abrahamu ndi mkazi wake Sara. Komeneko ndi kumene anaika Isaki ndi mkazi wake Rebeka. Ndipo komeneko ndi kumene ndidika Leya.
Munda ndi phanga analigula kwa aHiti.'
Yakobo atamaliza kuuza ana ake izi, anaikira mapazi ake pa bedi, analuma mpweya wake, napita pamodzi ndi makolo ake.
Yosefe anapondera bambo wake nalira namupsya.
Pamenepo Yosefe analamula ataotchi omwe ankamtumikira kuti akonzere mtembo wa bambo wake; ndipo Yakobo anambalirawa.
Nthawi yake inagwira masiku makumi anayi. Ndipo aEgipito anam'lilira masiku makumi asanu ndi khumi ndi awiri.
Maliro atamaliza, Yosefe anayankhula ndi akamwini a Farao nati, 'Chonde ndichitirani chisomo ndi kuyankhula ndi Farao chifukwa changa.

Muzimulotcha kuti bambo wanga anandikanikiza ndi lumbiro. Anauza, "Taima, ndikulowa imfa. Nditenga ku dziko la Kanani ndundike m'manda imene ndidizimbira." Chonde nditilole kupita kukadika bambo wanga. Pambuyo pake ndidzabwera.'
Farao anagwirizana ndi pempho la Yosefe. 'Pita ndikadike bambo wako, monga analumbirira,' anauza.
Choncho Yosefe anapita kukadika bambo wake. Akaanga onse a Farao, achifumu onse a nyumba ya Farao, ndi achifumu onse a Igupito anapita naye.
Komanso nyumba yonse ya Yosefe, ndi abale ake, ndi nyumba ya bambo wake anapita. Ana ang'ono awo ndi nkhosa ndi ng'ombe zawo anasiyira ku Gosheni.
Gulu lalikulu la magaleta ndi akavalo anapita nawo.
Atafika ku bululu ya Atadi pafupi ndi mtsinje wa Yordani, anachita phwando lalikulu la maliro, ndi kulira kwa masiku asanu ndi awiri kwa bambo wa Yosefe.
Anthu a dera limenelo, aKanani, ataona maliro pa bululu ya Atadi, anauza, 'Ici ndi maliro oopsa a aEgipito.' Chifukwa chake malo amenewo anatchedwa Abeli-Miziraimu, pafupi ndi Yordani.
Choncho ana a Yakobo anachita monga iye anawalamulira.
Anam'tenga ku dziko la Kanani namdika m'phanga la Makipela pafupi ndi Mamre. Ichi ndi chimene Abrahamu anagula kwa Efroni wHiti ngati malo okaikidwa kwamuyaya.
Yosefe atadika bambo wake, anabweranso ku Igupito pamodzi ndi abale ake ndi onse amene anapita nawo kudika bambo wake.
Koma tsopano bambo wawo atamwalira, abale a Yosefe anachita mantha. 'Tsopano Yosefe adzatipweteka ndipo adzatilipirira zoipa zonse zimene tinachita kwa iye,' iwo anauza.
Choncho anatumiza uthenga kwa Yosefe nati, 'Bambo wako asanafe, analamula

kuti tikuuze: "Chonde khululukira abale ako zoipa zimene anakuchitira, machimo awo pakukundizira kotere." Choncho tsopano, tikupempha, khululukira machimo a atumiki a Mulungu wa bambo wako.' Yosefe analira atamvera uthenga umenewu.
Pamenepo abale ake anabwera nagwa pansi pamaso pake. 'Taona, ife tili akapolo ako!' iwo anauza.
Koma Yosefe anauza, 'Musaope. Kodi ine ndine Mulungu?
Inu munafuna kundichitira choipa, koma Mulungu anachipanga kuti chikhale chabwino. Anandibweretsa kuno kuti nipulumutse miyoyo ya anthu ambiri.
Choncho musaope. Ndidzapitirira kusamalirani inu ndi ana anu.' Motero anawatonthozetsa ndi mawu afatsa.
Choncho Yosefe anakhala ku Igupito pamodzi ndi abale ake ndi mabanja awo. Yosefe anakhala zaka 110.
Iye anaona zidzukulu za mibado itatu za Efiraimu mwana wake, ndipo anaona mwana wa Makiri mwana wa Manase anabadwa ndipo anavomereza kumutenga kukhala wake.

'Posachedwa ndidzafa,' Yosefe anauza abale ake, 'koma Mulungu adzakuchitira chifundo ndipo adzakutulutsa m'dziko lino la Igupito. Adzakubwereretsa ku dziko limene analonjeza Abrahamu, Isaki, ndi Yakobo.'
Pamenepo Yosefe analumbirira ana a Israeli nati, 'Mulungu akadzabwera kukuthandizani, muzitenga mafupa anga ndi inu.'
Choncho Yosefe anamwalira ali ndi zaka 110. Anambalirawa, ndipo mtembo wake anasungidwa m'bokosi ku Igupito.
